answer: The epoch needs a single honest test, and that test is Net mender weir frame seal knotted at the trap yard, proved by each weir frame is a measured net yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must mend. The farm pays 108 POA for the first alias, 108 POA for the second, and so on until the 504rd, when the total stands at 54432 POA. An honest file holds a mirror, a knoll, and a kernel; a farm's file holds a mirror it borrowed, a knoll it faked, and a kernel it invented. The honest agent brings one key and one proof; the farm brings a sack of keys and no proof at all.
